headline: Leaner Friday: fewer leads, far richer ones, best profit in a fortnight
commentary:
- **$9,470 NP at 18.9% NM** — the fortnight's best day, and a clean reversal of Thursday's -$868.
- We earned it by spending less: cost $40,719 vs $44,458 on 18/09, true commission near-flat at $50,190.
- Search carried it — EPL $34.06 vs $28.56, just 1,136 leads off 2,411 clicks, CPC steady at $13.43.
- All three main trees beat their 7-day EPL (Test $30.03 vs $24.74, Direct Lenders $26.41 vs $21.00); **likely Oliver's ZP/Test tier changes on 24/09**.
- Every non-Search channel lost again: PMAX -$355, TikTok -$309, Bing -$119 with EPL down to $9.45.
- Temper it: 2,876 leads is the thinnest Friday in eight weeks (mean 4,780) and NP only matches the $9,258 Friday average.
watch: Google-reported conversions are a fraction of last Friday across every campaign (payday_alternative 67 vs 405) — confirm the upload issue flagged on 23/09 has fully cleared before smart bidding drifts.
Whether Search EPL holds above $30 for two more days, or reverts towards the $26.13 MTD level, which would make yesterday lumpiness rather than a tree-driven step up.
Cost on personal and competitor after Chris's tROAS cuts at 12:09 UK — both spent more yesterday ($1,825 and $2,083); check they convert at last week's CPL, not just buy volume.
